newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary Dec household savings up 48.9 bln forints.
newsitem.headline: Hungary Dec household savings up 48.9 bln forints.

text.p: Hungary's net household savings rose 48.9 billion forints in December to 2,391.7 billion forints, the National Bank of Hungary said on Friday.
The NBH said that the nominal value of net household savings rose by 32 percent in 1996 while in real terms the rise amounted to 10.1 percent.

Households continued to prefer bank deposits which accounted for 80 percent of the December savings growth, the NBH said, adding that this was partly due to the fact that some government securities matured in December and freed cash was temporarily put into bank accounts.
NOTE - Figures are not inflation adjusted. This year's figures are preliminary.
The consumer price inflation was 19.8 percent year-on-year in December.
